scope: One failed Windows unit shard of CLI CI, including its one automatic full-suite retry. This archive does not record or approve the full candidate gate.

github.snapshotLimit: Run metadata is a point-in-time snapshot and was still in_progress. The completed job failure is the finding; this is not a final all-jobs run conclusion.
github.exactSource: Job metadata head_sha and successful Verify exact source identity step agree; saved log records explicit checkout and git rev-parse comparison to the candidate SHA. Reusable workflow references include the PR merge SHA; this does not replace the explicitly checked-out source identity.

logProvenance.capture: Existing GitHub job log stdout saved as UTF-8 text through PowerShell by root. Embedded bytes and SHA-256 attest only that saved local text, not the original API response bytes.
logProvenance.normalizationForAnalysis: ANSI color sequences stripped for analysis only; embedded saved bytes are unchanged.

junit.provenance: Extracted read-only from the actual downloaded artifact ZIP, whose size and SHA-256 match the GitHub artifact API and upload log.
junit.attemptBinding: The same output path was written after each attempt; uploaded after the retry. Embedded suite timestamps are in the final 06:59:28Z report window.
junit.interpretation: JUnit retains 104 suites and 2500 testcases (2498 non-skipped, 2 skipped), including 86 headless assertions with suite time=0. It reports failures=0/errors=0 despite the stdout worker error and wrapper exit 1; these JUnit fields do not establish a successful run.

localHeadless.commandProvenance: Root-provided invocation parameters; launched from packages/cli without diagnostic preload. The log and JSON independently establish file/test results, not the exact process argv.
localHeadless.exitCodeSource: root tools.write_stdin session 45196 final exit_code; not independently encoded in the log or JSON report
localHeadless.limitation: Supplementary single-file local non-reproduction only. JSON was used for this local probe, while the failed hosted job used default plus JUnit. It does not reproduce hosted shard load/order or establish a root cause or release eligibility.

conclusions: Both hosted invocations failed: attempt 1 reported 104/104 completed files; automatic retry reported 103/104. Both reported 2498 passed tests, 2 skipped, and 1 unhandled Worker exited unexpectedly error.

headless-runner.test.js is the only file with a completion line in attempt 1 but none in attempt 2. The retry JUnit retains all 86 assertions; missing file completion does not mean those assertions were absent.
The hosted wrapper command used only default and JUnit reporters and exited 1. No JSON reporter was added to alter its worker-error acceptance path.
The available failed-job log does not record the worker exit code, signal, PID or pre-exit IPC ordering. The parent-only lifecycle diagnostic is separate pending work.
The bad.js SyntaxError is intentional negative-test output and is not established as the worker-exit cause.
No source modification, retry suppression, timeout change, full candidate recording, tag or publication is authorized by this evidence.
